patthana3.8:1.1: nonīvaraṇaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nonīvaraṇo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana3.8:2.1: hetuyā ekaṃ ārammaṇe ekaṃ avigate ekaṃ.
patthana3.8:4.1: paṭiccavāro nīvaraṇaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nīvaraṇo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: nīvaraṇaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nonīvaraṇo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: nīvaraṇaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nīvaraṇo akusalo ca nonīvaraṇo akusalo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
patthana3.8:6.1: nīvaraṇaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nīvaraṇo akusalo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā: vicikicchānīvaraṇaṃ uddhaccanīvaraṇaṃ paṭicca avijjānīvaraṇaṃ.
patthana3.8:7.1: nonīvaraṇaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nīvaraṇo akusalo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā: vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca avijjānīvaraṇaṃ.
patthana3.8:8.1: nīvaraṇaṃ akusalañcano nīvaraṇaṃ akusalañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nīvaraṇo akusalo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā: vicikicchānīvaraṇañca uddhaccanīvaraṇañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca avijjānīvaraṇaṃ.
patthana3.8:9.1: nahetuyā tīṇi naadhipatiyā nava napurejāte nava …pe… navippayutte nava.
patthana3.8:11.1: pañhāvāro nīvaraṇo akusalo dhammo nīvaraṇassa akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo:.
patthana3.8:12.1: hetuyā tīṇi ārammaṇe nava adhipatiyā nava avigate nava.
patthana3.8:16.1: yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomampi paccanīyampi anulomapaccanīyampi paccanīyānulomampi gaṇitaṃ evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.

patthana3.8:18.1: hetuyā ekaṃ ārammaṇe ekaṃ avigate ekaṃ.
